column1: # TVI-WO-1202a: each case's and mutant's wall time in seconds, the weight tools/tviburi-route plan packs shards by.
# Re-weighed by TVI-WO-1308 (ruled 2026-11-26T09:31Z Q16: an eleventh shard, re-weighed from main's last code CI) from main's CI run
# 45774342008 (the push of 39e51af: 970 items, 433 cases and 537 mutants, ten shard jobs, four CPU models) with 1202a's method: an
# item's time is the gap from the previous item's last line to its own. Each shard's speed is its median item against the
# previous weights (items of 1 s or more), over the median of the run's Intel Xeon 6975P-C shards (four, at 1.041 against the
# previous weights; the EPYC 7763 shards ran at 1.49 1.43 (two), the EPYC 9V74 at 1.12 1.11, the EPYC 9V45 at 0.88 0.99, the 6975P-C at 0.98 1.01 0.99 1.01);
# an item weighs its time divided by its shard's speed. So every weight is at the 6975P-C's speed (1.00). The 93 items the
# previous table lacked (the adc-* cases and AD* mutants among them) are measured, and the unmeasured-mean rows are replaced.
# The previous weights (1307's run, then each later WO's own runs) are in this file's git history.
# Never the list of what runs: that is the tree's own (tests/spike.sh, tests/mutants.tsv); an item missing here
# weighs its kind's median and still runs. KIND<tab>ID<tab>SECONDS.
# Four cases logged their RAN line in the same second as the item before (timer-regen, dma-regen, adv-noname, rcc-onehome):
